pages.text: Global lines start at x=5: PROGRAM, INCLUDE, STRUCT, FUNCTION and global VARIABLE and CONSTANT lines. Lines inside a code block are one block further east than its BEGIN.

A code block starts with BEGIN and ends with END. END is followed by the keyword that opened the block, like $(1)END FUNCTION$() or $(1)END WHILE$(). A code block may not be empty.$(br2)Variables and constants made inside a code block only live inside it. They are forgotten when the block ends.
